basic_info.description: Large two-story Edwardian home in its original condition (circa 1916), features ornate woodwork, wainscoting, built-ins and hardwood floors throughout. The main floor has a spacious living rm with fireplace, formal dining room with built-in cabinets, breakfast rm, original kitchen, quarter bath & laundry rm with BR overlooking the backyard completes this level. Grand staircase takes you to the top level which boasts 4 light-filled BRs & full BA. HW flrs throughout. The garage can accommodate one very large car and has plenty of storage. The deep 25x120' lot offers ample outdoor space. Enjoy views of the Golden Gate Bridge towers from the front landing. Fabulous location. Walk to Golden Gate Park, Geary St. shops, restaurants & transportation & short drive to Ocean Beach. Great opportunity to restore this home to its former glory.
